name: Neith Corporation
summary: Neith Corporation operates in diverse sectors, encompassing biotechnology, medical aesthetics, and preventive health solutions. The company provides a variety of nutritional supplements, including L-One, a liquid formula designed to support ocular well-being, and EPlus, a multi-enzyme blend. Additional nutritional offerings are marketed under the King One brand. Beyond supplements, Neith also offers genetic testing services. Its product portfolio extends to a wide array of wellness and energy-enhancing items, such as versatile mattresses (energy and dual-purpose), energy-infused masks, silicon gel necklaces, waistbands, heated energy stones, and massage tools. The company further supplies water purification systems and specialized Ganbanyoku energy stone spa beds. In the beauty segment, Neith presents a line of skincare products focused on cell regeneration and rejuvenation. Other offerings include energy-focused household items, as well as microcontrollers and their associated peripheral devices. Established in 1997, Neith Corporation was initially known as Come True Biomedical Inc. The company's headquarters are situated in Taichung, Taiwan.
